target: Ableton Live 12 Suite 12.4.3, arm64, macOS host (not this Linux host)
policy: ADR-0002 runtime escalation; run in one Phase 4 sitting; retain captures; no scanner or Live execution on the analysis host
shared_setup: Fresh macOS user account or a moved-aside Live preferences folder; Live 12.4.3 arm64; process-argument capture by a tool whose availability is established first (for example `ps -axww -o pid,ppid,args` polling or the Endpoint Security `eslogger exec`); sqlite3 for read-only copies of the plug-in database; test plug-ins built from the public VST3 SDK samples and a minimal VST2-compatible bundle only if a licensed VST2 SDK is available

probes.question: Exact argv Live passes to Ableton Plugin Scanner: --db path, --cid form, --vst2/--vst3 ID=PATH lists and domain IDs, --reset value, --limit, --lang, and whether --au is ever passed
probes.existing_evidence: Scanner options at 0x1001308e0 (cid, db, vst3, vst2, reset, lang, limit, verbose); Live arm64 strings --db/--cid/--reset/--au/--vst2/--vst3 at slice offsets near 0x5be57e4; scanner registers no au option
probes.why_static_insufficient: Argument assembly is Live-side code not yet traced; the domain IDs are runtime strings
probes.minimal_input: One VST3 in /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3, one in ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3; Plug-In Sources toggled through: system VST3 on/off, custom VST3 folder on/off, VST2 system on/off; Rescan with and without the Option modifier (whether a modifier changes the scan is itself unverified)
probes.discriminating_observation: Captured argv per configuration; presence or absence of --au; --reset value per rescan kind
probes.stop_condition: One capture per configuration listed, or 30 minutes

probes.question: What happens observably when a module crashes the scanner: restart count, module scanstate sequence, browser listing
probes.existing_evidence: Static derivation: crashed module stays scanstate 0; next session UpdateUnconfirmedPluginsAndModulesState (0x1005a8258) sets it to 4 (on-retry) and the unchanged-fingerprint skip at 0x1005e9fd8 skips it; the following session sets 4 to 2 (disabled). Live string 'Plugins: scanner process stopped prematurely.  Restart'
probes.why_static_insufficient: Live-side restart policy and whether another session follows within the same rescan are not traced; the derivation may miss exception handlers
probes.minimal_input: VST3 sample whose GetPluginFactory calls abort(); one healthy VST3 alongside
probes.discriminating_observation: Number of scanner launches; plugin_modules.scanstate for the crashing module after each launch and after a second manual Rescan; whether the healthy plug-in is listed; any user-visible message
probes.stop_condition: Crashing module reaches scanstate 2, or three manual rescans without change

probes.question: Hang handling: does Live time out or kill a scanner stuck in a plug-in load, and after how long
probes.existing_evidence: No timeout or alarm in the scanner scan path; helper watchdog constants 5000/20000/20000/1000/2000/4000 at 0x1009a8ff0 whose meaning is unmapped
probes.why_static_insufficient: Timeout ownership is Live-side or in the shared IPC state machine
probes.minimal_input: VST3 sample whose factory blocks forever
probes.discriminating_observation: Time from scanner start to its termination, the terminating signal, the module's scanstate afterwards, Live log lines

probes.question: Chunking: modules loaded per scanner session and restart behaviour with more than 50 new modules
probes.existing_evidence: limit default 50 (0x32 in 0x1001308e0); run state 2 when limit < count (0x100138504); count increments only after a module is confirmed; main sends scan=interrupted; Live string 'finished a chunk of work.  Continue'
probes.why_static_insufficient: Whether Live passes --limit, and the exact boundary (static derivation gives up to 51 confirmed modules per format per session)
probes.minimal_input: 60 copies of the VST3 sample with distinct bundle names and class IDs
probes.discriminating_observation: Scanner launch count and modules confirmed per launch (scanstate=1 rows over time, or --verbose log if available)

probes.question: Does changing a module's executable size or modification time trigger a re-check, including for a disabled module
probes.existing_evidence: VST3 fingerprint = hex(st_size):hex(st_mtime) of the bundle executable (0x1001458a4); skip requires equal fingerprint and scanstate != 0; PrepareModuleForRescan resets scanstate to 0
probes.why_static_insufficient: Confirms the derivation and the user-visible effect
probes.minimal_input: The disabled module from PRB-H1-02 with its crash removed and the executable replaced; separately `touch` of a healthy module's executable
probes.discriminating_observation: plugin_modules.fingerprint and scanstate before and after Rescan; browser listing

probes.question: Where Audio Units are discovered (in Live or in a helper) and where their results are stored
probes.existing_evidence: Scanner architecture table includes AU (1) but no AU scan code or option was found; Live has UseAUv2/UseAUv3 preferences and a --au string
probes.why_static_insufficient: Live-side; static tracing not yet done
probes.minimal_input: One AU v2 effect installed; Use Audio Units v2 on
probes.discriminating_observation: Whether any helper process starts with AU arguments; rows with arch=1 in the plugin database

probes.question: Location and lifetime of the plug-in database and of the scanner's optional PluginScanner.txt log configuration
probes.existing_evidence: Default name Live-plugins-{}.db formatted with 1 (0x1005a2b84) in a folder from an unresolved path service (0x1001c5f40); PluginScanner.txt parsed for log.level and log.categories (0x10019a9d8)
probes.why_static_insufficient: The path service resolves at run time
probes.discriminating_observation: --db argument from PRB-H1-01; file listing of the Live preferences and cache folders before and after

probes.question: Duplicates: the same bundle reachable from two scan roots, and two bundles exposing the same VST3 class ID
probes.existing_evidence: Candidates deduplicated by canonical path per domain (0x1005e8cb4); modules keyed by (path, domain) in AddModuleCandidate (0x1005a4318); no class-ID dedup found in the scanner
probes.minimal_input: A VST3 in both system and user folders (copy, then symlink); two different bundles with identical class IDs
